cards.title: A balanced scale
cards.idea: A pan balance holds 3x + 2 on the left and x + 8 on the right, resting level. Both sides are equal.

interaction.prompt: Tap the pan that carries more x blocks

cards.reveal: The left pan has 3 x-blocks, the right has 1. The scale stays level only because equality holds: 3x + 2 = x + 8.

cards.title: Move the x blocks together
cards.idea: To solve, gather all x on one side. Remove one x-block from both pans so the balance stays level.

interaction.prompt: Drag one x-block off each pan

cards.reveal: Removing x from both sides keeps balance: 3x + 2 - x = x + 8 - x, giving 2x + 2 = 8. All x now sits on the left.

cards.title: Isolate x
cards.idea: Now 2x + 2 = 8. Remove 2 units from each side, then split what remains between the 2 x-blocks.

interaction.prompt: Slide to subtract 2 from both sides, then share equally

cards.reveal: 2x + 2 - 2 = 8 - 2 gives 2x = 6, so x = 3. The same move on both sides keeps the equation true.

cards.title: The rule
cards.idea: With variables on both sides: do the same operation to both sides. Collect variables on one side, numbers on the other, then divide.

interaction.prompt: Tap to confirm the goal of each step

cards.reveal: Every valid step keeps both sides equal. The aim is to reach x = a single number.

cards.title: When it flips
cards.idea: Solve 5x - 4 = 2x + 5. Collecting x on the left needs subtracting 2x from both sides.

workbook.prompt: To solve 4x + 1 = 2x + 9, what is a correct first step?
options: Add 2x to the left side only
Subtract 1 from the left side only

workbook.prompt: Solve 3x + 2 = x + 8. The value of x is ________.
